'''''Viburnum treleasei''''' ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]: '''''folhado'''''), the '''Azorean laurustinus''', is a species in the genus ''[[Viburnum]]'' endemic to the [[Azores]]. It inhabits natural forests of ''[[Juniperus brevifolia]]'', ''[[Laurus azorica]]'' and ''[[Ilex perado]]'', ''[[Erica azorica]]'', in sloping areas. Generally at altitudes above {{convert|200|m|abbr=on}}. It is present in eight of the nine islands.<ref name=flora.on>{{cite web |title=''Viburnum treleasei'' Gand. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1Viburnum+treleasei |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=26 October 2020}}</ref>
